scope: Chrome 153 restoration of genuine AVI MPEG-4 Part 2 to fragmented 3GP packet copy under the unchanged 250 MiB complete-browser limit

browser.name: Chrome
browser.memoryFormula: peak complete Chromium process-tree private memory during conversion - stable clean blank-Chromium process-tree private memory

source.audio: mp3, explicitly excluded from the certified 3GP output

acceptedTopology.directSave: Quota-preflighted synchronous browser-private stage followed by one backpressured 256 KiB copy to the selected destination; staging deleted on success, cancellation, and failure.
acceptedTopology.opfsTest: Existing synchronous OPFS path without an additional final copy.

directSaveSessions.cancellation: early destination-opening cancellation, no retained output
final-copy cancellation after 21233664 output bytes, no retained output or stage
final-copy cancellation after 21495808 output bytes, no retained output or stage

opfsSession.cancellation: earliest observable running state, no retained output

adverseBrowserChecks.injectedFinalCopyWriteFailure: The destination rejected a bounded write; 262144 bytes had been attempted, pending and queued operations returned to zero, OPFS entries were empty, and the partial selected destination was removed.
adverseBrowserChecks.workerCrash: Injected conversion worker crash; worker restarted to ready, OPFS entries were empty, and the partial selected destination was removed.
adverseBrowserChecks.failedOpfsCancellationProbe: One earlier probe waited for 256 KiB input and missed the fast completed conversion. The harness was corrected to cancel at the earliest observable OPFS running state; the corrected three-run gate passed. The conversion itself did not fail.

rejectedCandidates: The 2026-09-21 audit records unchanged two-worker direct writing at 253.871 MiB, one-worker asynchronous direct writing at 258.027 MiB, and synchronous input at 280.125 MiB. None met the memory cap.
speedDecision: The accepted staged direct path is slower than the rejected direct writers but is the fastest tested path here that satisfies the unchanged memory and cleanup requirements; no unsupported speedup is claimed.
limitations: The measured 6 MiB direct-save headroom is narrow and does not guarantee other machines or browser versions. App-owned staging temporarily consumes approximately one output-sized amount of browser-private disk space before deletion.
